name: Bryce
source:
As the chief of police, Bryce is a dragon of many skills - and responsibilities. As a leader, it is his mission to set an example for his fellow peers. Though he is not perfect, he actively tries to break bad habits. He began his new hobby of building wooden models to train his fine motor skills and combat his tendency to rush into situations.

[From [url=https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/angels-with-scaly-wings--3#/]Indiegogo[/url]]
